content.question: Why is L2-regularization (Ridge) often preferred in multicollinearity scenarios?
options: It tends to spread the weight among correlated features rather than singling one out.
It eliminates all correlated features from the model.
It forces the coefficients of correlated features to be exactly zero.
It converts the problem into a classification task.
content.answer: It tends to spread the weight among correlated features rather than singling one out.
